title: White Linen Midi Dress with Shirt Collar, Button Front & Pockets
description:
Crisp, cool and effortlessly elegant – a pure linen midi dress made for sunny days, holidays and long lunches. A sharp shirt collar opens into a soft V-neck, a full row of buttons runs down the front, and the A-line skirt falls to a graceful midi length with a front slit for easy movement. Side pockets make it as practical as it is pretty.

✦ The Details
• Sleeveless A-line midi dress with a shirt collar and V-neckline
• Full front button placket with pearl-finish buttons
• Front slit at the hem for easy movement
• Side pockets
• Midi length

✦ Fabric & Craft
Made from pure linen with a soft cotton lining, so it stays breathable and comfortable while never feeling see-through. Linen softens beautifully with every wash and naturally creases a little – that relaxed texture is part of its charm. Stitched in our own Jaipur unit.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with an easy A-line skirt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Sunglasses, a rattan bag and clear heels for brunch or a vacation day. Add a denim jacket or a camel trench in cooler weather. For an evening out, pearl drop earrings and strappy sandals.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Midi Dress (pure linen with cotton lining)
care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash cold on a delicate cycle. Dry in shade. Iron while slightly damp on medium heat.
